title: Demo control panel
description: Everything here enters the CRM through the same path real Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and WhatsApp leads will use.

noAccess.title: The demo panel is for owners and managers
noAccess.description: Sign in as an owner or manager to run the demo.

script.title: Try this
script.step1: Open as {{name}} in a new window.
script.step3: Watch it arrive in {{name}}'s Leads with a 15-minute countdown.
script.nextIsSomeoneElse: Leads rotate between reps: the next one goes to {{next}}. Click again, or open {{nextFirst}}'s window instead.
script.manual: Lead assignment is set to manual, so new leads arrive unassigned and every rep sees them.

ads.title: Leads from ads
ads.description: A lead form arrives, is assigned round-robin and gets a 15-minute task.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.description: The message lands in the inbox live and the assignee gets a notification.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: See how the team keeps up when many leads arrive at once.

existingPatient.label: Inbound WhatsApp from an existing patient
existingPatient.hint: A follow-up that fits where they are, like "Can I move my consultation to Saturday morning?"

unknownNumber.label: Inbound WhatsApp from an unknown number
unknownNumber.hint: A first message from a new number becomes a WhatsApp lead with its conversation.

burst.label: Burst: 10 leads
burst.hint: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and WhatsApp mixed, like a busy Thursday evening.

phone.label: Route to this phone
phone.hint: New leads and unknown-number messages use this number instead of a random one. Use your own to rehearse the real-phone demo; in this showcase nothing is sent to it.

reps.title: Rep windows
reps.description: Each window signs in on its own, so you stay here as {{name}}.
reps.openLabel: Open as {{name}} in a new window
reps.emptyTitle: No reps in this workspace yet
reps.emptyDescription: Invite a teammate with the rep role to open their view side by side.

log.title: Recent simulated events
log.description: Only in this window. Newest first.
log.emptyDescription: Leads and messages you create here show up in this list, with a link to each one.

toast.repeatBody: {{name}} already has an open lead, so the enquiry was added to it.
toast.resetBody: The clinic's story is back at its starting point.

reset.title: Reset demo data?
reset.description: Every lead, deal, message and setting goes back to the clinic's starting story, and changes made during the demo are lost. Open windows stay signed in.
